evidence.title: Orthogonal JEPA: Factorized Predictive States for Latent World Models

summary: A new paper proposes Orthogonal JEPA, a method for factorized predictive states in latent world models, aiming to improve AI's understanding of complex environments. The approach builds on Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to enhance representation learning.
title: Researchers Introduce Orthogonal JEPA for Advanced Latent World Models in AI
